name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.

keyboard.description: Moves focus between the buttons in the group, same as any sequence of focusable elements.

accessibilityNotes: The `ButtonGroup` root renders `role="group"` so assistive tech announces the buttons as one related set.
Use `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on `ButtonGroup` to give the group an accessible name, especially when it has no visible heading.
Icon-only buttons inside a group (a split-button's second button, a dropdown or popover trigger) need their own `aria-label` — the group's label does not substitute for a per-button accessible name.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Buttons that share adjacent borders and merge their corners.

examples.title: Orientation
examples.source:
import ButtonGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button-group/button-group.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<ButtonGroup orientation="vertical" aria-label="Clipboard actions" class="h-fit">
  <Button type="button" variant="outline">Copy</Button>
  <Button type="button" variant="outline">Paste</Button>
  <Button type="button" variant="outline">Duplicate</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
examples.description: Set `orientation="vertical"` to stack the group instead of rowing it.

examples.title: Nested
examples.source:
import ButtonGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button-group/button-group.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroup>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm">1</Button>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm">2</Button>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm">3</Button>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm">4</Button>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm">5</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroup>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" aria-label="Previous">Prev</Button>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" aria-label="Next">Next</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
</ButtonGroup>
examples.description: Nest `ButtonGroup` components to add spacing between related clusters of buttons.

examples.title: Separator
examples.description: `ButtonGroupSeparator` visually divides buttons within a group. Buttons with the `outline` variant already have a border and rarely need one; other variants benefit from it.

examples.title: Input
Input Group
examples.source:
import ButtonGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button-group/button-group.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
import InputGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input-group.marko";
import InputGroupInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input.marko";
import InputGroupAddon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/addon.marko";
import InputGroupButton from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/button.marko";
import Tooltip from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tooltip/tooltip.marko";
import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko";

<let/voiceEnabled=false/>

<ButtonGroup class="[--radius:9999rem]">
  <ButtonGroup>
    <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="icon" aria-label="Add">
      <Icon name="PlusIcon"/>
    </Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroup>
    <InputGroup>
      <InputGroupInput
        placeholder=(voiceEnabled ? "Record and send audio..." : "Send a message...")
        disabled=voiceEnabled
      />
      <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
        <Tooltip content="Voice Mode">
          <@trigger|triggerProps|>
            <InputGroupButton
              ...triggerProps
              onClick() { voiceEnabled = !voiceEnabled; }
              size="icon-xs"
              data-active=String(voiceEnabled)
              class="data-[active=true]:bg-orange-100 data-[active=true]:text-orange-700 dark:data-[active=true]:bg-orange-800 dark:data-[active=true]:text-orange-100"
              aria-pressed=(voiceEnabled ? "true" : "false")
              aria-label="Voice Mode"
            >
              <Icon name="AudioLinesIcon"/>
            </InputGroupButton>
          </@trigger>
        </Tooltip>
      </InputGroupAddon>
    </InputGroup>
  </ButtonGroup>
</ButtonGroup>
examples.description: Wrap an `InputGroup` to create complex input layouts.

examples.title: Dropdown Menu
examples.source:
import ButtonGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button-group/button-group.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
import DropdownMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import type { DropdownMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko";

static const ITEMS = [
  { value: "mute", label: "Mute Conversation" },
  { value: "read", label: "Mark as Read" },
  { value: "report", label: "Report Conversation" },
  { value: "block", label: "Block User" },
  { value: "share", label: "Share Conversation" },
  { value: "copy", label: "Copy Conversation" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "delete", label: "Delete Conversation", variant: "destructive" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[];

<ButtonGroup>
  <Button type="button" variant="outline">Follow</Button>
  <DropdownMenu items=ITEMS class="w-44">
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <Button type="button" variant="outline" ...triggerProps class="pl-2!" aria-label="More Options">
        <Icon name="ChevronDownIcon"/>
      </Button>
    </@trigger>
  </DropdownMenu>
</ButtonGroup>
examples.description: Create a split button group with a `DropdownMenu`.

examples.title: Select
examples.description: Pair with a `Select`. Upstream's `SelectTrigger` accepts arbitrary children and renders the bare currency symbol via a `font-mono` class; ours always shows the selected item's `label` (`valueAsString || placeholder`) with no custom-content slot, so the trigger reads 'US Dollar' rather than a bare '$'.

examples.description: Set `dir="rtl"` on a wrapping element for RTL text and logical-property layout. `DropdownMenu` doesn't expose the underlying Zag menu's `dir` prop, so this doesn't drive floating-ui's own RTL placement flip. Upstream's RTL demo also drives a live language switcher (English/Arabic/Hebrew); this one is static Arabic content, like every other RTL example on this site.
